items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Verdi's, some of these operas we did.

ctx.x: I had a fellow with me, a young Italian fellow. And like, with the Overture of 1812, some of those, he worked with me, cooperated with me, in making some of the -- like Puccini's opera, and Verdi's, some of these operas we did. Because, like, when we went into the Negresco Hotel, we had to play for supper, you see, and you couldn't play the dance music. Had to play little excerpts from different operas or symphonies, or something like that. So that's how that happened.
What did this Italian do? Did he help you with the arrangements?
